text: Garbage has not been collected for four days near the PCMC main building in Pimpri.
The dustbin outside our society is overflowing and stray dogs are spreading the waste everywhere.
Ghanta gadi has not come to our lane in Nigdi since Monday.
हमारी गली में तीन दिन से कचरा नहीं उठाया गया है, बहुत बदबू आ रही है।
आमच्या सोसायटीसमोर कचऱ्याचा ढीग पडला आहे, घंटागाडी येत नाही.
People are dumping construction waste and plastic bags on the empty plot near Chinchwad station.
There is a huge pothole on the main road near Akurdi railway station, two bikes fell yesterday.
The road in front of our school is completely broken after the rains.
Spine road pe bahut bade khadde hai, gaadi chalana mushkil hai.
सड़क पर बड़े-बड़े गड्ढे हो गए हैं, रात को दुर्घटना का खतरा है।
रस्त्यावर मोठे खड्डे पडले आहेत, दुचाकीस्वार पडत आहेत.
Road digging for cable work was left unfinished for a month near Wakad.
The street light outside house number 12 has not been working for a week, the lane is completely dark.
Street lights on Telco Road stay on during the daytime, wasting electricity.
Hamare area me street light band hai, raat ko bahut andhera rehta hai.
हमारी कॉलोनी की स्ट्रीट लाइट दस दिन से खराब है।
आमच्या गल्लीतील पथदिवे बंद आहेत, रात्री खूप अंधार असतो.
The electric junction box of the street light pole is open and wires are hanging out.
We have not received any water supply for the last two days in Sector 25.
Tap water is coming very dirty and smells bad, it is not drinkable.
Paani bahut kam pressure se aata hai, upar ki tanki bharti hi nahi.
हमारे इलाके में पानी की पाइपलाइन फट गई है और पानी बर्बाद हो रहा है।
आमच्या भागात दोन दिवसांपासून पाणी आले नाही.
Water supply timing keeps changing every day, sometimes it comes at 3 am.
The drain in our lane is blocked and sewage water is overflowing onto the road.
There is an open manhole without a cover near the bus stop, very dangerous for children.
Gutter ka paani ghar ke saamne bah raha hai, bahut smell aa rahi hai.
नाली चोक हो गई है और गंदा पानी सड़क पर फैल रहा है।
ड्रेनेज तुंबले आहे, सांडपाणी रस्त्यावर वाहत आहे.
Sewage line is leaking into the basement of our building.
After yesterday's heavy rain the whole road near Pimple Saudagar is flooded with knee-deep water.
Rainwater collects in front of our society every monsoon because the storm water drain is blocked.
Barish ke baad poora road paani se bhar jaata hai, nikaas nahi hai.
बारिश का पानी सड़क पर जमा हो जाता है, निकासी की व्यवस्था नहीं है।
पावसाचे पाणी रस्त्यावर साचते, पावसाळी नाले साफ केलेले नाहीत.
The traffic signal at Nashik Phata junction has not been working for three days causing huge jams.
Trucks are parked on both sides of the road near MIDC Bhosari, blocking traffic every evening.
Chowk pe signal band hai, roz traffic jam hota hai.
चौक पर ट्रैफिक सिग्नल खराब है, रोज़ जाम लगता है।
चौकातील सिग्नल बंद आहे, त्यामुळे वाहतूक कोंडी होते.
Vendors have occupied the entire footpath near Pimpri market, pedestrians have to walk on the road.
A shop owner has extended his shed onto the public road in front of his shop.
Footpath pe hawkers ne kabza kar liya hai, chalne ki jagah nahi.
फुटपाथ पर फेरीवालों ने कब्जा कर लिया है।
पदपथावर फेरीवाल्यांनी अतिक्रमण केले आहे, चालायला जागा नाही.
The public toilet near the bus stand is extremely dirty and has no water.
Stagnant water in the empty plot is breeding mosquitoes, many people in our area have dengue.
Public toilet bahut ganda hai, koi saaf nahi karta.
हमारे इलाके में मच्छर बहुत बढ़ गए हैं, फॉगिंग नहीं हुई।
सार्वजनिक शौचालय अत्यंत अस्वच्छ आहे.
A pack of stray dogs in our lane chases children and two-wheelers every night.
A dead dog has been lying on the road near our gate since yesterday.
Gali me awara kutte bahut hai, ek bachche ko kaat liya.
सड़क पर आवारा गायें बैठी रहती हैं, दुर्घटना होती है।
आमच्या भागात भटक्या कुत्र्यांचा खूप त्रास आहे.
A big tree fell on the road during the storm and is blocking traffic.
The garden in our sector is not maintained, the grass is overgrown and swings are broken.
Ek ped ki daal bijli ke taar pe latak rahi hai, kabhi bhi gir sakti hai.
पार्क की देखभाल नहीं होती, झूले टूटे हुए हैं।
वादळामुळे मोठे झाड रस्त्यावर पडले आहे.
Someone burns plastic waste every evening near our society, the smoke is unbearable.
A factory is releasing chemical water into the Pavana river.
Raat ko loudspeaker bahut tez bajta hai, sona mushkil hai.
पास की फैक्ट्री से काला धुआं निकलता है, सांस लेने में तकलीफ होती है।
पवना नदीत रसायनमिश्रित पाणी सोडले जात आहे.
My property tax bill shows double the amount compared to last year.
I paid property tax online but the receipt still shows the amount as pending.
Property tax ka bill galat aaya hai, area zyada likha hai.
मेरे संपत्ति कर के बिल में गलत राशि दिखाई गई है।
मालमत्ता कराचे बिल चुकीचे आले आहे.
An illegal fourth floor is being constructed next to our building without permission.
The old building on our street has big cracks and may collapse any time.
Bagal wali building bina permission ke upar ek aur manzil bana rahi hai.
बिना अनुमति के अवैध निर्माण हो रहा है।
शेजारी परवानगीशिवाय अनधिकृत बांधकाम सुरू आहे.
The benches in the bus shelter are broken and the roof is leaking.
The public signboard showing the ward office direction has fallen down.
Bus stop ka shed toota hua hai, barish me log bheegte hain.
सार्वजनिक बस स्टॉप का शेड टूटा हुआ है।
उद्यानातील बाक तुटलेले आहेत आणि दिवे नाहीत.
Live electric wire has fallen on the road after the storm, people are walking near it.
The compound wall of the municipal school is about to collapse onto the footpath.
Raat ko is road pe chain snatching hoti hai, koi light ya CCTV nahi hai.
खुले बिजली के तार लटक रहे हैं, किसी को करंट लग सकता है।
उघड्या विजेच्या तारा लोंबकळत आहेत, अपघाताचा धोका आहे.
The municipal school in our area has no drinking water for students.
Teachers are absent most days at the PCMC primary school in Kalewadi.
Nagar nigam school me bachchon ko mid-day meal time pe nahi milta.
महानगरपालिका स्कूल में बच्चों के लिए शौचालय नहीं है।
महापालिकेच्या शाळेत शिक्षक वेळेवर येत नाहीत.
I applied for a birth certificate two months ago and have still not received it.
The citizen facilitation centre staff asked for extra money to process my application.
Marriage certificate ke liye teen baar office gaya, kaam nahi hua.
जन्म प्रमाणपत्र के लिए आवेदन किया था, अब तक नहीं मिला।
मृत्यू दाखल्यासाठी अर्ज करून महिना झाला, अजून मिळाला नाही.
I want to suggest that PCMC start a mobile app for paying all bills in one place.
Please thank the cleaning staff of Ward 14, they are doing a great job.
मुझे PCMC के बारे में कुछ सामान्य जानकारी चाहिए।
